mods.name: BuildFromChests
mods.description: Building with the hammer uses materials from chests near you (default 20 m), not just your inventory.
mods.notes: First release: build pieces using materials from nearby chests.

mods.name: CraftFromChests
mods.description: Crafting stations use materials from nearby chests. Buttons beside the crafting tabs show lines to the chests in use and cycle the range (5-30 m).
mods.notes: Chest-lines and range buttons beside the crafting tabs; reload-safe for hot reloading.

mods.name: ModUpdater
mods.description: This mod manager (F7). Updates itself like any other mod.
mods.notes: Mods that exist only on your machine (not published yet) now get a proper card with Reload and Disable instead of a plain line; only loader plugins are listed separately.

mods.name: PartyHud
mods.description: Party panel on the right of the screen: every player's Steam picture, name, health, stamina and distance, live, at any range.
mods.notes: Polish: rounded panels, bars and pictures with soft shadows, fade-in for new players, a PARTY header, F8 to hide/show the panel, and a cap on how many players are listed.

mods.name: QualityOfLife
mods.description: Small controls: hover items and press Q to build a quick set, press Q in the world to swap to it and back; press B to jump into construction mode with your hammer and back. Keys are configurable.
mods.notes: First release: a quick set you build from your inventory (swap to it and back with one key) and a hammer key that jumps into construction mode and back. Both keys are configurable.
